    {"id": "IRQ-CLAIM", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."},

    {"id": "t_latency", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-LATENCY", "IRQ-MASK"], "description": "Goal: irq and irq_id are combinational from the registers.     {"id": "a_mask", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK"], "description": "Always: irq == |(PENDING & ENABLE)."},
    {"id": "a_priority", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"], "description": "Always: if irq, then PENDING[irq_id] & ENABLE[irq_id], and no lower index j has PENDING[j] & ENABLE[j]; if !irq, then irq_id == 0."},
    {"id": "a_claim_format", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"], "description": "Always: addr==3 implies rdata == {irq, 26'b0, irq_id}."},
    {"id": "a_reset", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "description": "!rst_n at a rising edge implies ENABLE, MODE, PENDING and the stored previous source level are all zero at the next cycle."},
    {"id": "a_level_set", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"], "description": "For each i, with rst_n high: !MODE[i] && src[i] implies PENDING[i] in the next cycle, regardless of ENABLE and of any concurrent W1C or acknowledge write."},
    {"id": "a_edge_set", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"], "description": "For each i, with rst_n high and MODE[i]: src[i] && !$past(src[i]) implies PENDING[i] in the next cycle.     {"id": "a_ack", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "description": "On a write with we && addr==3, for each i with no detection at that edge: PENDING[i] next == PENDING[i] && !(wdata[4:0]==i && i<N). ENABLE and MODE are unchanged."},

    {"id": "a_read_no_side_effect", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-READ", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "description": "!we implies ENABLE and MODE are stable, and PENDING changes only through detection. rdata equals the selected register combinationally in every cycle. irq and irq_id are pure functions of the current PENDING and ENABLE."},
    {"id": "c_mode_x_enable", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"], "description": "Cross, per source, of MODE (level/edge) x ENABLE (0/1) x a detection event."},

    {"id": "c_irq_id_values", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-CLAIM"], "description": "Every irq_id value 0..N-1 seen with irq high, and irq_id==0 seen with irq low and with irq high; multiple enabled pending sources seen at once."},
